description: Defines types, enums, and classes for representing GLSL shader variables, interface blocks, and related concepts within the ANGLE project, including shader variable metadata, interface block structures, and work group size specifications.

classes.name: ShaderVariable
classes.description: Represents a shader variable (uniform, varying, attribute, etc.) with metadata such as type, name, array sizes, layout, and link-time comparison methods.

classes.name: InterfaceBlock
classes.description: Represents an interface block in GLSL shaders, including its name, layout, fields, and array size.

classes.name: WorkGroupSize
classes.description: Encapsulates the size of a compute shader work group, with methods to set, compare, and validate local sizes.

methods.name: InterpolationTypesMatch
methods.description: Validates if two interpolation qualifiers are compatible.

methods.name: isSameUniformAtLinkTime
methods.description: Determines if two uniform variables are equivalent at shader link time.

methods.name: isSameInterfaceBlockFieldAtLinkTime
methods.description: Checks if two interface block fields are equivalent at link time.

methods.name: isSameVaryingAtLinkTime
methods.description: Checks if two varyings are equivalent at link time, considering shader version.

methods.name: isSameVariableAtLinkTime
methods.description: Internal method to compare shader variables for link-time equivalence.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the work group size with a specified value.

methods.name: setLocalSize
methods.description: Sets the local size dimensions for compute shaders.

methods.name: isWorkGroupSizeMatching
methods.description: Checks if two work group size declarations match.

methods.name: isAnyValueSet
methods.description: Checks if any size value is set in the work group size.

methods.name: isDeclared
methods.description: Checks if all size values are declared.

methods.name: isLocalSizeValid
methods.description: Validates whether the local size values are either all set or all unset.
